title: Gold Set Build: Sample 100 clinical sessions, de-identify, package with integrity

test_cases.name: Dataset packages at least 100 curated clinical sessions
test_cases.evidence: Verified 171 gold set cases available (exceeds requirement of 100)

test_cases.name: Balanced linguistic sampling across Arabic and English
test_cases.input_setup: Analyze audio_language attribute distribution in gold dataset
test_cases.evidence: Both languages robustly sampled: Arabic=82, English=89

test_cases.name: De-identification: zero direct patient identifiers in gold set
test_cases.input_setup: Regex scan 100 gold cases for phone numbers, national IDs, and SSN formats
test_cases.expected_result: Zero direct identifier regex matches found
test_cases.evidence: De-identification verified: zero real patient identifier patterns detected

test_cases.name: Clinical department representation in gold package
test_cases.input_setup: Analyze department attribute distribution in gold candidates
test_cases.expected_result: OPD and ER have >= 20 cases each; Dental included
test_cases.evidence: Clinical department breakdown: OPD=131, ER=37, Dental=3

test_cases.name: Dataset packaging integrity verified with SHA-256
